lines.t: Before the crowns, before the thrones
Before our fathers carved their stones
You were
Yahuwah, Yahuwah
Beyond the reach of numbered stars
No hidden thing escapes your heart
You are
Yahuwah, Yahuwah
Elohim, you spoke the heavens
Called the light and named the day
Every breath belongs to mercy
Every world beneath your reign
Not a creature made its maker
Not a kingdom formed your throne
All the wonders we discover
Tell of wisdom yours alone
In the garden came the whisper
Calling death the harmless road
We believed the voice that tempted
Turned away from what we knew
Still your mercy was not silenced
Still your purpose would remain
You would bring the lost to shelter
You would break the tempter's claim
We have bowed before the borrowed
We have praised what you have made
Turn our faces to the giver
Let our idols fall away
Yahuwah, yours is the wisdom
Yahuwah, yours is the might
Holy in all of your judgments, faithful through all of our night
Power that no throne can borrow, love that no darkness can claim
Mercy has reached us in Yahushua
Let every nation praise your name
Moses sang about the nations
Jacob held as your own shed
Yet your people turned to demons
Gave the worship, hold you there
Stone and silver could not save them
Falsehood could not make them free
You remain their rock and maker
Calling them from treachery
Babylon would climb the heavens, lift his throne above the stars
Tyre grew proud of all its splendor, claiming what was never ours
Crowns cannot become their maker, beauty cannot purchase right
You bring low the proud oppressor, bring the hidden into light
Not the height of our ambition
Not the riches in our hands
Only truth can stand before you
Only by your gift we stand
Yahuwah, yours is the wisdom
Yahuwah, yours is the might
Holy in all of your judgments
Faithful through all of our night
Power that no throne can borrow, love that no darkness can claim
Mercy has reached us in Yahushua, let every nation praise your name
Daniel humbled himself before you, from the first his words were heard
Persia's prince opposed the messenger but could not size what you purposed
Michael stood within the struggle
Greece's prince would also come
Earthly kingdoms were not all there was
Yet the final word was yours
Yahushua, you faced the darkness
Spirits trembled at your word
Through your death and resurrection
Victory would be declared
To the spirits held in prison
There was proclamation made
Angels' powers, authorities
Made subject to your reign
Teach us not to worship wonders
Teach us not to chase the dark
What you give, let us receive it
What you keep, we leave with you
Let the knowledge you have granted bear compassion, faith, and truth
We could learn the names of kingdoms and still fail to walk with you
Defend the poor, uphold the fatherless, deliver those beneath the cruel
No thrown excuses, wickedness, the judge is answerable to you
Worlds beyond the home you gave us, lives beyond the things we know
All our creatures of your making, none beyond your judgment go
Some watch near, and some from far off, good and evil are not one
Neither hide nor hidden passage shields rebellion from your hand
Those below and those above us
Those who pass the bounds between
All are subject to your purpose
Not one secret goes unseen
Let no power steal our worship
Let no terror rule our breath
You alone remain our refuge, Yahushua
Our life from death, Yahushua
Yours is the wisdom, Yahuwah
Yours is the might
Holy in all of your judgments
Faithful through all of our night
Power that no throne can borrow
Love that no darkness can claim
Mercy has reached us in Yahushua
Let every nation praise your name
For your wisdom, we adore you
For your power, we bow down
For your love, our hearts give thanks
For your mercy, hear our song
The earth is yours
Our breath is yours
